acceptanceCriteria: Historical archive, Contract, verification evidence, and recovery bytes remain immutable.
A supported command creates a successor revalidation record while the predecessor remains pending close.
Current Contract revalidation evidence is bound to the current Contract and archive manifest, while old evidence remains independently auditable.
The successor can complete start, preflight, checkpoint, verify, finish, archive, provider finalization, and close with explicit human authorization.
After successor closure, predecessor closure records historical revalidation, old evidence identity, current Contract identity, and human authorization.
Missing, malformed, foreign, stale, symlinked, or contradictory evidence fails closed without repository writes.
Three-language documentation describes the command, immutable-history boundary, and historical versus current evidence.
goal: Preserve immutable historical archive/evidence, bind current Contract revalidation to a successor, and permit auditable terminal closure without false evidence.
intent: Provide an append-only recovery path for archived Work Items whose Contract was legitimately amended after historical verification.
sources: Object-repository report: archived Contract amendment leaves predecessor verification stale and recovery blocked (2026-09-05)
crates/cockpit-repository/src/lib.rs: recovery decision validation, archived evidence, successor scaffold, and close gates
